questions.passage: If I had scored 20 points higher on the SAT, I might have gotten into Yale. If I had one more extracurricular activity, I might have gotten into Princeton. In contrast, the satisficer UVA student had zero counterfactuals, as this person found a school that met all their requirements and they did not apply to any other. No alternative, no counterfactual, no regret.
questions.prompt: What does the compressed phrase 'No alternative, no counterfactual, no regret' summarise?
questions.promptZh: No alternative, no counterfactual, no regret 这一简短表达概括什么？
options: The satisficer example links not pursuing alternatives with fewer imagined better outcomes and regret.
All students lack the ability to imagine other universities.
The Cornell student applied to only one school.
Universities never provide applicants with alternative offers.
optionsZh: 满意即可者的例子把不追逐其他选项与缺少反事实设想和后悔相连。
所有学生都无法想象其他大学。
康奈尔学生只申请一所学校。
大学从不提供其他录取选择。
analyses: A 结语收束前面 UVA 学生找到满足要求的学校、未申请别处的例子；不能扩大成所有人永不后悔。
B 指定例子的 counterfactuals 为零不是否定所有人的想象能力。
C 前文说康奈尔学生申请十所，角色错配。
D 没有大学永远不提供选择的规定。保留原书的压缩短语，不扩写为新的英文原句。

vocabulary.meaning: 反事实设想；与现实不同的假如情形

questions.passage: There is a strong belief among some Americans that going to an elite school is the path to a happy life, when in reality having a good-enough mindset is the more reliable route. If you did not get into your top school, stop thinking about it and start looking for what is good about your current school. Easier said than done, but that will make you happier.
questions.prompt: Which approach does the author recommend in this passage?
options: Keep dwelling on rejection from the preferred school.
Avoid noticing positive features of the current school.
Adopt a good-enough mindset and notice what is good about the current school.
Treat entry to an elite school as a guarantee of happiness.
questions.promptZh: 本段中，作者推荐哪种做法？
optionsZh: 持续想着被最想去的学校拒绝。
避免注意现在学校的优点。
采取足够好的心态，并发现当前学校的好处。
把进入名校当作幸福保证。
analyses: A stop thinking about it 与持续反刍相反。
B start looking for what is good 正是鼓励注意优点。
C 同时保留 good-enough mindset 和对当前学校的积极关注。
D 这是 some Americans 的信念，作者随后提出不同看法。

evidence.quote: having a good-enough mindset is the more reliable route.

questions.passage: Closely related to the maximizer mindset, upward social comparison is another source of unhappiness. Jim Clark, who cofounded Netscape, had a series of successes as a Silicon Valley entrepreneur.
questions.prompt: Which description of Jim Clark is given here?
questions.promptZh: 这里怎样介绍吉姆·克拉克？
options: A journalist who interviewed Michael Lewis.
A researcher who conducted the tenure experiment.
A Netscape cofounder with several successes as a Silicon Valley entrepreneur.
An entrepreneur said never to have achieved a business success.
optionsZh: 采访迈克尔·刘易斯的记者。
进行终身教职实验的研究者。
网景联合创始人，在硅谷创业中多次成功。
被说成从未取得商业成功的创业者。

C cofounded Netscape 与 a series of successes as a Silicon Valley entrepreneur 直接说明身份经历。

questions.passage: He recounted to journalist Michael Lewis how he had initially thought he would be happy if he made $10 million early on. But then Netscape was a smashing success. He now thought he would be happy if he made $100 million. But then there was another smashing success, and he now thought he would be really happy if he made $1 billion. Then he did make $1 billion. Now he said, “I want…more money than Larry Ellison. Then I will stop.”
questions.prompt: What does Jim Clark’s sequence of wealth targets chiefly illustrate?
options: Comparing fortunes proves that wealth is unrelated to any life outcome.
Financial success guarantees satisfaction once a fixed target is reached.
Every successful entrepreneur measures happiness in exactly the same way.
Repeated success need not end dissatisfaction when comparison targets keep moving.
analyses: A 该段讨论向上比较与幸福，不支持财富与所有人生结果毫无关联。
B 一再更换目标正好削弱固定财富门槛能保证满足的想法。
C 只有一个人的叙述，不能推广到 every entrepreneur。
D need not 保留有限结论，moving targets 概括目标逐次变化。

evidence.quote: He now thought he would be happy if he made $100 million.
Now he said, “I want…more money than Larry Ellison. Then I will stop.”

vocabulary.context: 取得成功后财富目标仍不断提高
vocabulary.example: The concert was a smashing success.

questions.prompt: What does 'a smashing success' mean in the description of Netscape?
questions.promptZh: 描述网景的 a smashing success 是什么意思？
options: A limited success barely meeting expectations.
A very great or impressive success.
A business failure that ended the ambition.
A success that had only been predicted, not achieved.
optionsZh: 勉强达到预期的有限成功。
极为显著的巨大成功。
终结抱负的商业失败。
只是预测而尚未发生的成功。

B 这是修饰商业表现的强调用语，表示巨大成功。
